description: Candidate port of nera-data-layer public_api_triples at 2b1504adc4291daaf080b2e932962b134da1a69a.

stages.name: inventory
stages.query:
SELECT *, module || '::' || CASE WHEN class_name IS NULL THEN name ELSE class_name || '.' || name END AS id,
 module || '.' || CASE WHEN class_name IS NULL THEN name ELSE class_name || '.' || name END AS fqname
 FROM (SELECT __path,__start,__end,name,class_name,return_annotation,class_start,body_start, replace(rx_replace(__path, '/__init__\.py$|\.py$', ''), '/', '.') AS module, CASE WHEN class_name IS NULL THEN 'function' ELSE 'method' END AS kind FROM raw_functions
 UNION ALL SELECT __path,__start,__end,name,NULL,NULL,NULL,body_start,replace(rx_replace(__path, '/__init__\.py$|\.py$', ''), '/', '.'),'class' FROM raw_classes)

stages.name: declarations
stages.query: SELECT * FROM (SELECT *,row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY id ORDER BY __start DESC) AS selected FROM inventory) WHERE selected=1

stages.name: decorators
stages.query: SELECT * FROM raw_decorators

stages.name: parameters
stages.query:
SELECT p.*, d.id AS symbol FROM raw_parameters p JOIN declarations d ON d.__path=p.__path AND d.__start=p.owner
 WHERE d.class_name IS NULL OR p.name NOT IN ('self','cls')

stages.name: annotation_names
stages.query:
SELECT d.id AS symbol,a.name FROM raw_return_annotations a JOIN declarations d ON d.__path=a.__path AND d.__start=a.owner
 UNION SELECT p.symbol,a.name FROM raw_parameter_annotations a JOIN parameters p ON p.__path=a.__path AND p.__start=a.parameter

stages.name: imports
stages.query:
WITH RECURSIVE
 tokens(path,ordinal,top,base,item,rest) AS (
 SELECT __path,__start,top,base,'',rx_replace(items,'#[^\n]*','') || ',' FROM raw_imports
 UNION ALL SELECT path,ordinal,top,base,trim(substr(rest,1,instr(rest,',')-1),' ()' || char(10) || char(13)),substr(rest,instr(rest,',')+1) FROM tokens WHERE rest<>''),
 parts AS (SELECT *,rx_extract(item,'^(\S+)',1) AS original, rx_extract(item,'\s+as\s+(\S+)$',1) AS alias,
 replace(rx_replace(path,'/__init__\.py$|\.py$',''),'/','.') AS module FROM tokens WHERE item<>''),
 relative(path,ordinal,top,base,original,alias,module,prefix,remaining) AS (
 SELECT path,ordinal,top,base,original,alias,module,CASE WHEN path LIKE '%/__init__.py' THEN module ELSE rx_replace(module,'\.?[^.]+$','') END,
 coalesce(length(base)-length(ltrim(base,'.'))-1,-1) FROM parts
 UNION ALL SELECT path,ordinal,top,base,original,alias,module,rx_replace(prefix,'\.?[^.]+$',''),remaining-1 FROM relative WHERE remaining>0),
 resolved AS (SELECT *,CASE WHEN base IS NULL THEN original WHEN base NOT LIKE '.%' THEN base || '.' || original
 ELSE CASE WHEN prefix='' THEN '' ELSE prefix || '.' END || CASE WHEN ltrim(base,'.')='' THEN '' ELSE ltrim(base,'.') || '.' END || original END AS target,
 coalesce(alias,CASE WHEN base IS NULL THEN rx_extract(original,'^[^.]+',0) ELSE original END) AS name FROM relative WHERE remaining<=0)
 SELECT path,ordinal,top,module,name,target,CASE WHEN base IS NULL THEN 'module' ELSE 'symbol' END AS kind
 FROM (SELECT *,row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY module,name,base IS NULL ORDER BY ordinal DESC) AS selected FROM resolved WHERE original<>'*') WHERE selected=1

stages.name: resolved_names
stages.query:
WITH RECURSIVE names(fqname,symbol) AS (
 SELECT fqname,id FROM declarations UNION
 SELECT i.module || '.' || i.name,n.symbol FROM names n CROSS JOIN imports i ON i.target=n.fqname
 WHERE i.kind='symbol' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM declarations d WHERE d.fqname=i.module || '.' || i.name))
 SELECT * FROM names

stages.name: base_edges
stages.query:
SELECT d.id AS owner,b.id AS base,r.__start AS ordinal FROM raw_bases r JOIN declarations d ON d.__path=r.__path AND d.__start=r.owner
 JOIN declarations b ON b.kind='class' AND b.id=coalesce(
 (SELECT c.id FROM imports i JOIN declarations c ON c.fqname=i.target AND c.kind='class'
 WHERE i.kind='symbol' AND i.module=d.module AND i.name=trim(rx_replace(rx_replace(r.name,'(?s)\[.*$',''),'^.*\.','')) LIMIT 1),
 (SELECT c.id FROM declarations c WHERE c.module=d.module AND c.kind='class' AND c.name=trim(rx_replace(rx_replace(r.name,'(?s)\[.*$',''),'^.*\.','')) LIMIT 1),
 (SELECT min(c.id) FROM declarations c WHERE c.kind='class' AND c.name=trim(rx_replace(rx_replace(r.name,'(?s)\[.*$',''),'^.*\.','')) HAVING count(*)=1))

stages.name: hierarchy
stages.query:
WITH RECURSIVE walk(owner,base,depth,route,seen) AS (
 SELECT id,id,0,'',',' || id || ',' FROM declarations WHERE kind='class' UNION ALL
 SELECT w.owner,e.base,w.depth+1,w.route || printf('%012d.',e.ordinal),w.seen || e.base || ',' FROM walk w JOIN base_edges e ON e.owner=w.base WHERE instr(w.seen,',' || e.base || ',')=0)
 SELECT owner,base,depth,route FROM (SELECT *,row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY owner,base ORDER BY depth,route) AS selected FROM walk) WHERE selected=1

stages.name: public_methods
stages.query:
SELECT owner,name,symbol FROM (
 SELECT h.owner,d.name,d.id AS symbol,row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY h.owner,d.name ORDER BY h.depth,h.route) AS selected
 FROM hierarchy h JOIN declarations c ON c.id=h.base JOIN declarations d ON d.module=c.module AND d.class_name=c.name
 WHERE d.kind='method' AND substr(d.name,1,1)<>'_' AND d.name NOT IN ('__aenter__','__aexit__','__enter__','__exit__','__init__','__repr__','__str__','authorize_internal_access','disable_thread_affinity_checks','get_thread_checks_disabled','set_disable_thread_checks','validate_legacy_delegates','versioned_read','versioned_write')
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM decorators x WHERE x.__path=d.__path AND x.owner=d.__start AND rx_matches(x.name,'property$|\.setter$|\.deleter$'))) WHERE selected=1

stages.name: all_names
stages.query: SELECT * FROM raw_all_names

stages.name: explicit_exports
stages.query: SELECT *,row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY __path ORDER BY __start) AS selected FROM raw_all

stages.name: export_names
stages.query:
SELECT path,module,name,target FROM imports WHERE top IS NOT NULL AND kind='symbol' AND rx_matches(path,'^data_layer/[^/]+\.py$')
 UNION ALL SELECT __path,module,name,fqname FROM declarations WHERE class_name IS NULL AND rx_matches(__path,'^data_layer/[^/]+\.py$')

stages.name: exported_roots
stages.query:
SELECT DISTINCT e.path,e.module AS export_module,e.name AS export_name,n.symbol FROM export_names e JOIN resolved_names n ON n.fqname=e.target
 LEFT JOIN explicit_exports a ON a.__path=e.path AND a.selected=1
 WHERE substr(e.name,1,1)<>'_' AND (a.__path IS NULL OR (a.array IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM all_names v WHERE v.__path=e.path AND v.owner=a.__start AND v.name=e.name)))

stages.name: execution_calls
stages.query: SELECT * FROM raw_execution_calls

stages.name: traits
stages.query:
SELECT d.*,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM decorators x WHERE (x.__path=d.__path AND x.owner=d.__start) AND rx_matches(x.name,'(?:legacy_sync|legacy_module_sync|direct_legacy_module_sync)$')) AS legacy_sync,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM decorators x WHERE (x.__path=d.__path AND x.owner=d.__start) AND rx_matches(x.name,'(?:legacy_async|legacy_module_async|direct_legacy_module_async)$')) AS legacy_async,(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM decorators x WHERE (x.__path=d.__path AND x.owner=d.__start) AND rx_matches(x.name,'pure_lazy|apply_lazy_to_public_lazy_methods|(?:^|\.)lazy$')) OR (substr(d.name,1,1)<>'_' AND rx_matches(d.name,'_lazy$') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM decorators x WHERE (x.__path=d.__path AND x.owner=d.__start OR x.__path=d.__path AND x.owner=d.class_start) AND rx_matches(x.name,'pure_lazy|apply_lazy_to_public_lazy_methods|(?:^|\.)lazy$')))) AS lazy_decorated,
 EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM decorators x WHERE (x.__path=d.__path AND x.owner=d.__start OR x.__path=d.__path AND x.owner=d.class_start) AND rx_matches(x.name,'(?:^|\.)(?:internal_api|private_api|private_public_api)$')) AS private_api,(NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM decorators x WHERE (x.__path=d.__path AND x.owner=d.__start) AND rx_matches(x.name,'abstractmethod$')) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM decorators x WHERE (x.__path=d.__path AND x.owner=d.__start OR x.__path=d.__path AND x.owner=d.class_start) AND rx_matches(x.name,'(?:^|\.)(?:internal_api|private_api|private_public_api)$')) AND NOT (d.kind='function' AND d.__path IN ('l2055_lazy_result/lazy_reads.py','l2055_lazy_result/lazy_writes.py','l2055_lazy_result/transform.py') AND instr(d.name,'lazy_')=1 AND (rx_matches(d.name,'_lazy$') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM annotation_names a WHERE a.symbol=d.id AND lower(a.name) IN ('lazyresult','lazyseq','serverplan')))) AND NOT coalesce((d.__path IN ('l2055_lazy_result/execution_context.py','l2055_lazy_result/lazy_result.py','l2055_lazy_result/lazy_seq.py','l2055_lazy_result/transform.py') AND d.class_name IN ('BatchContext','EagerContext','LazyResult','LazySeq','OnAccessContext')),0) AND NOT coalesce((d.class_name IS NOT NULL AND (trim(d.return_annotation,' ' || char(39) || char(34))=d.class_name OR instr(trim(d.return_annotation,' ' || char(39) || char(34)),d.class_name || '[')=1)),0) AND ((rx_replace(d.name,'_(?:lazy|async|sync)$','') IN ('aggregate','commit','commit_branch','count','create_branch','cursor_paginate','cursor_paginate_with_total','delete_by_id','delete_by_key','delete_by_key_many','delete_many','execute','execute_one','exists','find_object_branches','find_object_revisions','first','fts_search','get_history','graph','graph_query','insert','insert_many','insert_many_raw','keyset_paginate','keyset_paginate_with_total','query','query_unfiltered','read','read_version','rollback','search','select_at_revision','select_many','select_one','table_exists','traverse','update','update_by_key','update_by_key_many','update_many','upsert','upsert_many','vector_search','write','write_version') AND (rx_matches(d.__path,'(?:/graph_query|/schema_transaction|/transaction|/versioned_transactions)') OR rx_matches(lower(coalesce(d.class_name,'')),'(?:connection|query|schematransaction|transaction|versioned)') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM annotation_names a WHERE a.symbol=d.id AND lower(a.name) IN ('databaseconnection','lazyresult','lazyseq','readtransaction','serverplan','versioneddatabaseconnection','versionedreadtransaction','versionedwritetransaction','writetransaction')))) OR (rx_matches(d.name,'_lazy$') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM annotation_names a WHERE a.symbol=d.id AND lower(a.name) IN ('lazyresult','lazyseq','serverplan'))) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM decorators x WHERE (x.__path=d.__path AND x.owner=d.__start) AND rx_matches(x.name,'(?:legacy_sync|legacy_module_sync|direct_legacy_module_sync)$')) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM decorators x WHERE (x.__path=d.__path AND x.owner=d.__start) AND rx_matches(x.name,'(?:legacy_async|legacy_module_async|direct_legacy_module_async)$')))) AS execution_surface,
 coalesce((SELECT json_group_array(name) FROM (SELECT name FROM parameters p WHERE p.symbol=d.id ORDER BY p.__start)),'[]') AS params,
 EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM decorators x WHERE (x.__path=d.__path AND x.owner=d.__start) AND rx_matches(x.name,'(?:^|\.)direct_legacy[^.]*$')) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM execution_calls e WHERE e.__path=d.__path AND e.owner=d.__start
 AND (e.name IN ('_fetchall','_fetchone','execute','execute_async','execute_fire_and_forget','execute_grammar','execute_grammar_fetchall','execute_grammar_fetchone','execute_raw','fetchall','fetchall_raw','fetchone','fetchone_raw','grammar_effect_lazy','grammar_fetchall','grammar_fetchall_async','grammar_fetchone','grammar_fetchone_async','grammar_row_lazy','grammar_rows_lazy','raw_execute') OR instr(e.name,'execute_grammar')=1 OR instr(e.name,'grammar_fetch')=1)
 AND (rx_matches(e.name,'_lazy$') OR instr(e.name,'lazy_')=1)) AS direct_lazy_wrapper
 FROM declarations d

stages.name: surfaces
stages.query:
SELECT *,CASE WHEN mixed THEN name ELSE rx_replace(name,'_(?:lazy|async|sync)$','') END AS base_name,
 CASE WHEN mixed AND scope='method' THEN '__invalid_mixed_name__' WHEN rx_matches(name,'_lazy$') THEN 'lazy' WHEN rx_matches(name,'_async$') THEN 'async'
 WHEN legacy_async THEN 'async' ELSE 'sync' END AS slot FROM (
 SELECT d.id AS symbol,d.name,d.legacy_async,d.execution_surface,'function' AS scope,r.export_module AS owner,r.export_module || char(0) || r.export_name AS ordinal,
 rx_matches(lower(d.name),'lazy') AND rx_matches(lower(d.name),'async|sync') AS mixed
 FROM exported_roots r JOIN traits d ON d.id=r.symbol WHERE d.kind='function' AND substr(d.name,1,1)<>'_' AND instr(d.__path,'_internal/')<>1
 UNION ALL
 SELECT d.id,d.name,d.legacy_async,d.execution_surface,'method',c.name,d.name,
 rx_matches(lower(d.name),'lazy') AND rx_matches(lower(d.name),'async|sync')
 FROM (SELECT DISTINCT symbol FROM exported_roots) r JOIN traits c ON c.id=r.symbol AND c.kind='class'
 JOIN public_methods p ON p.owner=c.id JOIN traits d ON d.id=p.symbol
 WHERE NOT c.private_api AND NOT d.private_api AND NOT rx_matches(c.name,'Protocol$|^Async')
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM raw_bases b WHERE b.__path=c.__path AND b.owner=c.__start AND instr(b.name,'Protocol')>0))

stages.name: slots
stages.query:
SELECT * FROM (
 SELECT *,min(ordinal) OVER (PARTITION BY scope,owner,base_name,slot) AS first_ordinal,
 row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY scope,owner,base_name,slot ORDER BY ordinal DESC) AS selected
 FROM surfaces WHERE NOT (scope='function' AND mixed)) WHERE selected=1

stages.name: family_groups
stages.query:
SELECT scope,owner,base_name,
 (SELECT symbol FROM slots x WHERE x.scope=s.scope AND x.owner=s.owner AND x.base_name=s.base_name ORDER BY x.first_ordinal LIMIT 1) AS exemplar,
 max(CASE WHEN slot='sync' THEN symbol END) AS sync_id,max(CASE WHEN slot='async' THEN symbol END) AS async_id,max(CASE WHEN slot='lazy' THEN symbol END) AS lazy_id,
 max(mixed) AS mixed,max(execution_surface) AS execution_surface,
 (SELECT json_group_array(json_array(slot,symbol)) FROM (SELECT slot,symbol FROM slots x WHERE x.scope=s.scope AND x.owner=s.owner AND x.base_name=s.base_name ORDER BY slot)) AS implementations
 FROM slots s GROUP BY scope,owner,base_name

cases.true:
SELECT g.* FROM family_groups g JOIN traits d ON d.id=g.exemplar WHERE g.mixed OR (NOT ((g.base_name IN ('plan','query','query_unfiltered') AND d.__path IN ('l2050_transaction/transaction.py','l7200_versioned_transactions/versioned_transactions.py') AND g.owner IN ('ReadTransaction','WriteTransaction','LazyVersionedReadTransaction','LazyVersionedWriteTransaction'))
 OR (g.owner='CacheTransaction' AND g.base_name IN ('commit','rollback')) OR (g.owner='BaseMigration' AND g.base_name='rollback')
 OR (g.base_name='execute_ddl' AND (g.owner IN ('SchemaTransaction','AsyncSchemaTransaction') OR d.__path='l2000_connection/schema_transaction.py'))
 OR (rx_matches(g.owner,'Connection$') AND g.base_name='table_exists')
 OR (g.sync_id IS NULL AND g.async_id IS NULL AND g.lazy_id IS NOT NULL AND (instr(lower(g.base_name),'bootstrap')>0 OR instr(lower(g.owner),'bootstrap')>0 OR g.base_name IN ('check_ddl_lockdown','column_exists','physical_table_exists_many','seal_table_exists_cache')))
 OR g.owner IN ('LazyVersionedReadTransaction','LazyVersionedWriteTransaction','SyncSessionHandle','AsyncSessionHandle','SyncVersionHandle','AsyncVersionHandle')
 OR rx_matches(g.owner,'^(?:Sync|Async|Lazy).*(?:Transaction|SchemaTransaction|SessionHandle|VersionHandle)$')) AND coalesce(g.execution_surface,0))
cases.false:
SELECT g.* FROM family_groups g JOIN traits d ON d.id=g.exemplar WHERE g.mixed OR NOT ((g.base_name IN ('plan','query','query_unfiltered') AND d.__path IN ('l2050_transaction/transaction.py','l7200_versioned_transactions/versioned_transactions.py') AND g.owner IN ('ReadTransaction','WriteTransaction','LazyVersionedReadTransaction','LazyVersionedWriteTransaction'))
 OR (g.owner='CacheTransaction' AND g.base_name IN ('commit','rollback')) OR (g.owner='BaseMigration' AND g.base_name='rollback')
 OR (g.base_name='execute_ddl' AND (g.owner IN ('SchemaTransaction','AsyncSchemaTransaction') OR d.__path='l2000_connection/schema_transaction.py'))
 OR (rx_matches(g.owner,'Connection$') AND g.base_name='table_exists')
 OR (g.sync_id IS NULL AND g.async_id IS NULL AND g.lazy_id IS NOT NULL AND (instr(lower(g.base_name),'bootstrap')>0 OR instr(lower(g.owner),'bootstrap')>0 OR g.base_name IN ('check_ddl_lockdown','column_exists','physical_table_exists_many','seal_table_exists_cache')))
 OR g.owner IN ('LazyVersionedReadTransaction','LazyVersionedWriteTransaction','SyncSessionHandle','AsyncSessionHandle','SyncVersionHandle','AsyncVersionHandle')
 OR rx_matches(g.owner,'^(?:Sync|Async|Lazy).*(?:Transaction|SchemaTransaction|SessionHandle|VersionHandle)$'))

stages.name: families
stages.query:
SELECT *,json_array(scope,owner,base_name,implementations) AS family FROM (
 SELECT *,row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY scope,base_name,implementations ORDER BY owner) AS selected FROM eligible_groups) WHERE mixed OR selected=1

stages.name: triple_violations
stages.query:
SELECT 'invalid_mixed_lazy_execution_name' AS issue,symbol,json_array(scope,owner,base_name,ordinal) AS family FROM surfaces WHERE scope='function' AND mixed
 UNION ALL SELECT 'invalid_mixed_lazy_execution_name',exemplar,family FROM families WHERE mixed
 UNION ALL SELECT 'missing_sync',exemplar,family FROM families WHERE NOT mixed AND sync_id IS NULL AND async_id IS NOT NULL
 UNION ALL SELECT 'missing_async',exemplar,family FROM families WHERE NOT mixed AND async_id IS NULL AND sync_id IS NOT NULL
 UNION ALL SELECT 'missing_lazy',exemplar,family FROM families WHERE NOT mixed AND lazy_id IS NULL
 UNION ALL SELECT 'missing_legacy_sync',f.sync_id,f.family FROM families f JOIN traits s ON s.id=f.sync_id JOIN traits l ON l.id=f.lazy_id WHERE NOT f.mixed AND s.params=l.params AND NOT s.legacy_sync
 UNION ALL SELECT 'missing_legacy_async',f.async_id,f.family FROM families f JOIN traits s ON s.id=f.async_id JOIN traits l ON l.id=f.lazy_id WHERE NOT f.mixed AND s.params=l.params AND NOT s.legacy_async
 UNION ALL SELECT 'missing_lazy_decorator',f.lazy_id,f.family FROM families f JOIN traits s ON s.id=f.lazy_id WHERE NOT f.mixed AND NOT s.lazy_decorated
 UNION ALL SELECT 'direct_wrapper_bypasses_lazy_owner',symbol,family FROM (
 SELECT f.family,s.symbol,row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY f.family ORDER BY d.__path,d.__start) AS selected
 FROM families f JOIN slots s ON s.scope=f.scope AND s.owner=f.owner AND s.base_name=f.base_name JOIN traits d ON d.id=s.symbol
 WHERE NOT f.mixed AND f.lazy_id IS NOT NULL AND s.slot IN ('sync','async') AND d.direct_lazy_wrapper) WHERE selected=1

relational.query: SELECT d.__path AS path,d.__start AS start_byte,d.__end AS end_byte,v.issue,v.family FROM triple_violations v JOIN traits d ON d.id=v.symbol
